integrity_notes: Source-date evidence is the first online publication of the motivating 2023 primary-MSC group-theory paper. Prior finite-group and endomorphism-semigroup results are acknowledged. No outside mathematical audit or priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to semidihedral groups of order at least 16. The 2002 article by Puusemp on prime-power cyclic semidirect products could contain uninspected stronger results, and its full text was unavailable for decisive historical-priority comparison. Four small groups are computationally corroborated but infinite correctness rests on the included proof.
title: Semidihedral endomorphism image spectra and a geometric index law
